description: Cross-tenant view: tenant inventory, apps per tenant, deployment types (static vs dynamic), build activity, and growth trends.

targets.expr: sum(loop_runtime_cell_tenant_count) or count(count by (tenant) (loop_runtime_deploys_total)) or vector(0)

panels.description: Each row is a tenant with its app count, deploy volume, build success rate, and domain count. Click tenant name to drill into Per-Tenant Health.
panels.title: Tenant ↔ Apps Inventory

panels.description: Number of distinct apps tracked per tenant. Derived from LoopRuntimeApplication CR ensure operations.
panels.title: Apps per Tenant

panels.description: Build outcomes by tenant over the selected time range. Green = SUCCEEDED, Red = FAILED, Yellow = CANCELLED.
panels.title: Build Outcomes by Tenant

panels.description: Static frontend deployments are delivered via Cloudflare KV + DO Spaces (zero pods). Dynamic apps run as pods in runtime cluster.
panels.title: Delivery Type Distribution

panels.description: Cloudflare KV operations over time. Each 'put' represents a static frontend deployment being published to the edge.
panels.title: Static Delivery Activity (CF KV)

panels.description: Running pods per tenant namespace in the runtime cluster. These are dynamic (containerized) workloads — static apps have zero pods.
panels.title: Dynamic Pods per Tenant

panels.description: Deploy rate per tenant over time. Higher rates indicate more active tenants. Spikes may indicate CI/CD pipelines or auto-deploy activity.
panels.title: Deploy Rate by Tenant

panels.description: Build duration (p95) per tenant. Increasing durations may indicate cache misses, larger builds, or resource contention.
panels.title: Build Duration p95 by Tenant

panels.description: Lock contention per tenant. High lock conflicts indicate concurrent deploy attempts hitting serialization. May need attention if consistently > 5.
panels.title: Lock Conflicts by Tenant

panels.description: Release convergence time (p95) per tenant — how long from release creation to ACTIVE state. Target: under 120s.
panels.title: Convergence p95 by Tenant

panels.description: Custom domain status per tenant. Healthy domains should be 'active'. Watch for stuck 'pending_ns' or 'provisioning' states.
panels.title: Custom Domains by Status

panels.description: All tracked apps across all tenants. Shows CR ensure success rate. Low success rate indicates operator issues for that app.
panels.title: App Catalog (All Tenants)

panels.description: GitHub auto-deploy webhook activity. Shows pushes that triggered deployments vs skipped vs errors.
panels.title: GitHub Auto-Deploy Activity

panels.description: Error-level logs from all tenant namespaces (loop-runtime-tn-*). Shows errors, panics, and fatal messages from user applications. Empty = no errors (healthy).
panels.title: Tenant App Errors (all namespaces)

panels.description: Error log volume per tenant namespace over time. Spikes indicate incidents. Click on a spike to drill into logs above.
panels.title: Error Volume by Tenant Namespace

panels.description: Platform infrastructure error logs — API, operators, ArgoCD, Argo Workflows. Helps correlate tenant issues with platform problems.
panels.title: Platform Errors (infra components)

panels.description: Total tenants over time, derived from cell_tenant_count metric. Tracks platform adoption.
panels.title: Tenant Count (over time)

panels.description: Cumulative deploys across all tenants. Shows platform-wide deployment activity trend.
panels.title: Total Deploys (cumulative)

panels.description: Tenants per cell. Monitors cell capacity for future auto-provisioning. Alert threshold: 500 tenants/cell (Phase 3).
panels.title: Tenants per Cell

title: LoopRuntime — Tenant Ecosystem
